name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]
  push:
    branches: [master]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  RUSTFLAGS: "-C target-feature=-crt-static"
  # llama.cpp (llama-cpp-sys-2) builds its HTTP client with HTTPS when CMake
  # finds OpenSSL. Shodh only loads local GGUF files and never uses llama.cpp's
  # downloader, so it is built without it: the result no longer depends on
  # which OpenSSL a runner has (OpenSSL 4 on macos-26 images from 20261012 does
  # not compile with the vendored cpp-httplib). llama-cpp-sys-2 passes CMAKE_*
  # variables to CMake, and llama.cpp's find_package(OpenSSL) is optional.
  CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_OpenSSL: "TRUE"

jobs:
  fmt:
    name: Format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1  # keep in sync with rust-toolchain.toml
          components: rustfmt
      - run: cargo fmt --all --check

  check:
    name: Check + Clippy
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1  # keep in sync with rust-toolchain.toml
          components: clippy

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      # Pinned, checksum-verified protoc from the official release (the
      # Chocolatey feed answers 503 at times while choco exits 0).
      - name: Install Protobuf compiler
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/ci/install-protoc.ps1

      - name: Cargo check
        run: cargo check --workspace

      # Blocking at the strongest level the workspace passes today. The harness and
      # audit modules additionally deny every warning via #![cfg_attr(clippy, deny(warnings))].
      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace -- -D clippy::correctness -D clippy::suspicious -D clippy::perf

  test:
    name: Tests
    runs-on: windows-latest
    needs: check
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1  # keep in sync with rust-toolchain.toml

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      # Pinned, checksum-verified protoc from the official release (the
      # Chocolatey feed answers 503 at times while choco exits 0).
      - name: Install Protobuf compiler
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/ci/install-protoc.ps1

      # Model-backed tests stay ignored here: SHODH_TEST_MODELS is not set in CI.
      - name: Tests (shodh-ontology)
        run: cargo test --package shodh-ontology

      - name: Library tests (shodh-rag)
        run: cargo test --package shodh-rag --lib

      - name: Library tests (shodh-rag-app)
        run: cargo test --package shodh-rag-app --lib

      - name: Tests (shodh-eval)
        run: cargo test --package shodh-eval

  # macOS reads scans with PP-OCRv6 only (Windows OCR is not built there), so
  # the parser and the OCR engine have macOS-only paths. This builds shodh-rag
  # on macOS and runs its OCR unit tests: one crate, debug, cached; the app and
  # the other crates are built on Windows only.
  macos:
    name: macOS build + OCR tests (shodh-rag)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    env:
      # The workflow's -crt-static is for the Windows MSVC builds.
      RUSTFLAGS: ""
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1  # keep in sync with rust-toolchain.toml

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      # LanceDB's protobuf definitions are compiled at build time.
      - name: Install Protobuf compiler
        run: brew install protobuf

      - name: OCR tests (shodh-rag)
        run: cargo test --package shodh-rag --lib ocr

  # Retrieval quality on the committed synthetic corpus (no LLM): a fresh
  # index, every question searched, gated against the committed baseline.
  # Retrieval is deterministic, so any drop fails; latency is reported only.
  # The scanned corpus (image-only pages) is gated the same way, read with the
  # PP-OCRv6 model installed with the search models; it fails when the OCR
  # model is missing rather than measuring another engine.
  eval-retrieval:
    name: Retrieval eval
    runs-on: windows-latest
    needs: check
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1  # keep in sync with rust-toolchain.toml

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      # Pinned, checksum-verified protoc from the official release (the
      # Chocolatey feed answers 503 at times while choco exits 0).
      - name: Install Protobuf compiler
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/ci/install-protoc.ps1

      # Same cache as the footprint job: the pinned search and OCR models,
      # keyed by the file that pins them.
      - name: Cache search models
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/shodh-models
          key: search-models-${{ hashFiles('crates/shodh-rag/src/embeddings/model_store.rs') }}

      - name: Install search and OCR models
        run: cargo run --package shodh-eval -- models --models "${{ runner.temp }}/shodh-models"

      - name: Retrieval eval
        run: >
          cargo run --package shodh-eval -- retrieval
          --corpus crates/shodh-eval/data/synthetic/corpus
          --dataset crates/shodh-eval/data/synthetic/dataset.json
          --models "${{ runner.temp }}/shodh-models"
          --out eval-out

      - name: Compare with baseline
        run: >
          cargo run --package shodh-eval -- compare
          --baseline crates/shodh-eval/data/synthetic/baseline.json
          --report eval-out/retrieval-report.json

      - name: Scanned retrieval eval (PP-OCRv6)
        run: >
          cargo run --package shodh-eval -- retrieval
          --corpus crates/shodh-eval/data/scanned/corpus
          --dataset crates/shodh-eval/data/scanned/dataset.json
          --models "${{ runner.temp }}/shodh-models"
          --ocr ppocr
          --out eval-out-scanned

      - name: Compare scanned with baseline
        run: >
          cargo run --package shodh-eval -- compare
          --baseline crates/shodh-eval/data/scanned/baseline.json
          --report eval-out-scanned/retrieval-report.json

      - name: Upload eval report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: eval-retrieval
          path: |
            eval-out/retrieval-report.json
            eval-out/retrieval-summary.md
            eval-out-scanned/retrieval-report.json
            eval-out-scanned/retrieval-summary.md
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  frontend:
    name: Frontend Typecheck + Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: app/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: app
        run: npm ci

      - name: Typecheck
        working-directory: app
        run: npx tsc --noEmit

      - name: Unit tests
        working-directory: app
        run: npm test

  # Memory and startup budget of the release build, on a fresh profile with
  # the search models installed (they load only when used).
  # scripts/measure-footprint.ps1 documents what is measured. Budgets are the
  # measured release build plus at most 10%, and never above the targets
  # (350 MB, 1.5 s). The idle figure assumes WebView2 runs with --disable-gpu
  # (profile.rs); with GPU compositing it would be about 115 MB more.
  #
  # Idle memory: five runs of 60 s, the median is gated at 163 MB. 148.6 MB
  # (median of 3 runs on a developer machine; 143-149 MB on this runner).
  #
  # Time to a usable window depends on the runner: the same build measured
  # 0.52-0.64 s on one windows-latest machine and 0.87-1.07 s on another, so a
  # raw number is not gated. The build is launched interleaved with other
  # builds on the same runner (each on its own profile, order rotating every
  # pair, one warm-up pair discarded, PAIRS measured pairs). Each build's time
  # is the mean of its fastest 20% of launches: runner noise only adds time,
  # and on the noisier runners it moves the median of 9 launches by more than
  # a 10% regression (measured on this PR's runs; medians are still logged).
  # Gated on ratios of those times:
  #   - Against the base commit's build (the merge commit's first parent), at
  #     most MAX_WINDOW_RATIO, set from master-against-itself runs.
  #   - Against a fixed anchor build (FOOTPRINT_ANCHOR_SHA, the code the 0.94 s
  #     budget was set from: 0.857 s, median of 5 runs on windows-latest):
  #     this build / anchor x 0.857 s must stay within 0.94 s. The anchor does
  #     not move with master, so a series of small regressions that each pass
  #     the ratio still reaches this ceiling.
  # The base commit's build comes from master's push run (artifact
  # footprint-exe-<sha>, uploaded right after its build), else from this PR's
  # cache, else it is built here (about 35 more minutes). The anchor is cached
  # and built the same way. Push runs on master upload their build and record
  # their time against the anchor.
  footprint:
    name: Footprint budget
    runs-on: windows-latest
    needs: check
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read  # find and download the base commit's build
    env:
      FOOTPRINT_ANCHOR_SHA: 76bf22ff6df23370b58b6af5d0684f0529efd2ab
      FOOTPRINT_ANCHOR_SECONDS: "0.857"
      PAIRS: "15"
      MAX_WINDOW_RATIO: "1.06"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2  # the merge commit's first parent is the base commit

      - name: Resolve the builds to compare
        id: builds
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          if ('${{ github.event_name }}' -eq 'pull_request') {
            $reference = git rev-parse HEAD^1
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'The merge commit has no first parent' }
            Write-Host "Reference: base commit $reference"
            "reference=$reference" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
          }
          Write-Host "Anchor: $env:FOOTPRINT_ANCHOR_SHA ($env:FOOTPRINT_ANCHOR_SECONDS s when the budget was set)"

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: 1.97.1  # keep in sync with rust-toolchain.toml

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          key: release

      # Pinned, checksum-verified protoc from the official release (the
      # Chocolatey feed answers 503 at times while choco exits 0).
      - name: Install Protobuf compiler
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/ci/install-protoc.ps1

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: app/package-lock.json

      - name: Build frontend
        working-directory: app
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build

      - name: Build release app
        run: cargo build --release -p shodh-rag-app --features tauri/custom-protocol

      # Copied out of target/: building the base commit or the anchor below
      # writes the same path.
      - name: Stage this build
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $dir = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path '${{ runner.temp }}/footprint-bin/pr'
          Copy-Item -LiteralPath target/release/shodh-rag-app.exe -Destination $dir

      - name: Upload this build for PRs based on it
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: footprint-exe-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/footprint-bin/pr/shodh-rag-app.exe
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: error

      - name: Download the base commit's build
        id: reference-artifact
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          $name = 'footprint-exe-${{ steps.builds.outputs.reference }}'
          $runId = gh api "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/artifacts?name=$name" --jq '[.artifacts[] | select(.expired == false and .workflow_run.head_branch == "master")][0].workflow_run.id // empty'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Listing the artifact $name failed" }
          if (-not $runId) {
            Write-Host "No artifact $name (master's push run has not uploaded it yet, or it expired): trying this PR's cache, else building it here."
            "found=false" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          }
          gh run download $runId --repo '${{ github.repository }}' --name $name --dir '${{ runner.temp }}/footprint-bin/reference'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Downloading $name from run $runId failed" }
          Write-Host "Base commit's build: artifact $name from run $runId"
          "found=true" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Restore the base commit's build
        id: reference-cache
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.reference-artifact.outputs.found != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/footprint-bin/reference
          key: footprint-reference-${{ steps.builds.outputs.reference }}

      - name: Restore the anchor build
        id: anchor-cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/footprint-bin/anchor
          key: footprint-anchor-${{ env.FOOTPRINT_ANCHOR_SHA }}

      # Same toolchain, flags and target directory as this build (registry
      # dependencies are reused), with each commit's own lockfile and frontend.
      - name: Build what was not stored
        id: build-missing
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $missing = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
          if ('${{ github.event_name }}' -eq 'pull_request' -and '${{ steps.reference-artifact.outputs.found }}' -ne 'true' -and '${{ steps.reference-cache.outputs.cache-hit }}' -ne 'true') {
            [void]$missing.Add(@{ Label = 'reference'; Sha = '${{ steps.builds.outputs.reference }}' })
          }
          if ('${{ steps.anchor-cache.outputs.cache-hit }}' -ne 'true') {
            [void]$missing.Add(@{ Label = 'anchor'; Sha = $env:FOOTPRINT_ANCHOR_SHA })
          }
          if ($missing.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host 'Every build to compare was downloaded or restored.'; exit 0 }
          $target = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'target'
          foreach ($build in $missing) {
            Write-Host "No stored $($build.Label) build of $($build.Sha): building it here."
            $src = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "footprint-src-$($build.Label)"
            git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin $build.Sha
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Fetching $($build.Sha) failed" }
            git worktree add --detach $src $build.Sha
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Checking out $($build.Sha) failed" }
            Push-Location (Join-Path $src 'app')
            npm ci
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "npm ci failed for $($build.Sha)" }
            npm run build
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Frontend build failed for $($build.Sha)" }
            Set-Location $src
            cargo build --release -p shodh-rag-app --features tauri/custom-protocol --target-dir $target
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Release build failed for $($build.Sha)" }
            Pop-Location
            $dir = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP "footprint-bin/$($build.Label)")
            Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $target 'release/shodh-rag-app.exe') -Destination $dir
            git worktree remove --force $src
            "$($build.Label)=true" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
          }

      - name: Cache the base commit's build
        if: steps.build-missing.outputs.reference == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/footprint-bin/reference
          key: footprint-reference-${{ steps.builds.outputs.reference }}

      - name: Cache the anchor build
        if: steps.build-missing.outputs.anchor == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/footprint-bin/anchor
          key: footprint-anchor-${{ env.FOOTPRINT_ANCHOR_SHA }}

      # The pinned search and OCR models (installed by the app itself, SHA-256
      # checked), cached by the file that pins them.
      - name: Cache search models
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/shodh-models
          key: search-models-${{ hashFiles('crates/shodh-rag/src/embeddings/model_store.rs') }}

      - name: Measure footprint
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $bin = '${{ runner.temp }}/footprint-bin'
          $opts = @{
            Exe                 = "$bin/pr/shodh-rag-app.exe"
            ModelPath           = '${{ runner.temp }}/shodh-models'
            InstallModels       = $true
            Scenario            = 'idle'
            Runs                = 5
            IdleSeconds         = 60
            BudgetIdleMB        = 163
            AnchorExe           = "$bin/anchor/shodh-rag-app.exe"
            AnchorWindowSeconds = [double]$env:FOOTPRINT_ANCHOR_SECONDS
            BudgetWindowSeconds = 0.94
            Pairs               = [int]$env:PAIRS
            WarmupPairs         = 1
            Output              = 'footprint.json'
          }
          if ('${{ github.event_name }}' -eq 'pull_request') {
            $opts.ReferenceExe = "$bin/reference/shodh-rag-app.exe"
            $opts.MaxWindowRatio = [double]$env:MAX_WINDOW_RATIO
          }
          ./scripts/measure-footprint.ps1 @opts

      - name: Upload footprint report
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: footprint
          path: footprint.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore
